interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body:
The prognosis is influenced by several factors, including a preoperative PSA of 4 ng/mL and an ISUP grade group 1 pathology. Countervailing findings include the absence of extraprostatic extension, seminal vesicle invasion, lymphovascular invasion, and no documented nodes removed. The positive surgical margins are concerning. Missing nodal sampling widens uncertainty regarding nodal status.

The trajectory of postoperative PSA is critical for refining this prognosis; any subsequent measurements would be highly informative. Given the current data limitations, the prognostic picture remains partially obscured by the lack of follow-up PSA values and definitive nodal assessment. The fixed horizon suggests a potential period without an observed event. The fixed estimated horizon is 76.69 months. This represents expected follow-up without an event, not a known recurrence date. The sensitivity range is 46.02–107.37 months; its coverage has not been validated.
